text.text: FlashBlade is the industry's first data hub purpose-built for unstructured data and modern analytics. It accelerates any workload, from data recovery to artificial intelligence, with cloud-like simplicity. FlashBlade is architected with the following six features: "Tuned For Everything": Optimized for any unstructured workload, from small to large files, random to sequential I/O access, to deliver the highest performance. Real-Time: Engineered to deliver millisecond latency for responsive applications. All-Flash: Fully optimized for modern storage media from software to hardware. Parallel: Built from the ground up to be massively parallel, eliminating any serial bottleneck in software and hardware, for modern workloads. Elastic: Allows compute and storage to be disaggregated to deliver cloud-like agility. Simple: Evergreen business model so you don’t rebuy TB you already own, and no manual tuning for performance.

text.text: Scale-Out Fabric with low-latency switching fabric connects Blades, Chassis, and 10,000s of clients together on one converged fabric. It includes a built in 40Gb Ethernet fabric providing a total network bandwidth of 320Gb/s for the chassis and supports major enterprise features, such as snapshots, SMB, LDAP, Network Lock Manager, and IPv6.

text.text: Delivers enterprise-class reliability with an N+2 design for redundancy. FlashBlade can tolerate two full blade failures and many more flash chip failures without data service interruption. The latest LDPC error recovery protects against flash bit errors, and all data is encrypted all the time. System automatically rebuilds to heal around failures.
